**Assessment/Plan:**

- **Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)** 
 Ms. Fernandez was diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus in July 2022. She presents with systemic organ involvement, which has been controlled effectively over the past few years. Her treatment regimen includes prednisone 10 mg daily, and she has remained in good health since her initial diagnosis. During follow-up visits, her physical examinations were within normal limits, and she reported no major complications from her condition. Laboratory findings consistently show no active disease flare-ups.

- **HIV** 
 Ms. Fernandez was diagnosed with HIV in December 2022. She has been on antiretroviral therapy (ART) for 6.5 years and has had an undetectable viral load for the past 39 months. Her CD4 is currently at 739 cells/mm³, indicating a well-controlled infection. She takes bictegravir-emtricitabine-tenofovir 50/200/25 mg daily, and there have been no reports of drug resistance or adverse effects. Routine monitoring of her HIV status shows stable clinical condition.

- **Social History**
